title: Cookbook:Champ (Irish Mashed Potato with Scallion)
wikitext:
{{Recipe summary
| Category = Potato recipes
| Servings = 2
| Difficulty = 2
}}

{{recipe}}

==Ingredients==
*1 [[Cookbook:Pound|lb]] (450 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]]) [[Cookbook:Potato|potatoes]], peeled 
*2 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]] (60 g) [[Cookbook:Green Onion|scallions]] 
*¼ [[Cookbook:Pint|pint]] (½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]]) [[Cookbook:Milk|milk]] 
*Freshly-ground [[Cookbook:Pepper|pepper]]
*[[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]] (optional)
*4 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]]

==Procedure==

# Boil potatoes in water until done.
# Drain the potatoes and [[Cookbook:Mashing|mash]] them. 
# Pour the milk into a [[Cookbook:Saucepan|saucepan]], add the chopped scallions and cook vigorously. 
# When cooked, sieve the scallions and set the milk aside. 
# Add the scallions to the potatoes and mix well. 
# Add as much of the scallion-infused milk as possible to make a ‘wet’ soft mixture.
# Season with freshly ground pepper and salt.
# Serve with a central well filled with melted butter.
